args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

Change dedupe function logic to properly detect duplicates when two statements overlap and are uploaded together, so duplicates between uploads are counted, not missed.

file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue here is in src/ingest/dedupe.ts where the dedupe function currently misses duplicates when two overlapping statements are uploaded together. The function only checks duplicate keys within the same batch against the seen set but not correctly for overlapping days in consecutive uploads. This PR branch repomind/issue-4633 has been opened to address this by improving duplicate detection logic.
